name: Moped
description: A motor-driven cycle with foot pedals for human propulsion and a motor of no more than two brake horsepower (1,500 W) that can't propel it past 30 mph on a level road; the traffic code holds only a combustion engine to 50 cc, so an electric motor qualifies. The registration chapter's definition is written around a 50 cc cylinder capacity.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and foot pedals that permit muscular propulsion by human power (Wyoming Statutes §§31-5-102(a)(xxi), 31-1-101(a)(xv)(C))
Its motor produces no more than two brake horsepower (1,500 W) and can't propel it faster than 30 mph on a level road (Wyoming Statutes §31-5-102(a)(xxi))
Anyone licensed to drive any class of vehicle may ride one
No helmet requirement: the minors' helmet law excludes moped riders
Needs at least one head lamp and one tail lamp
